title: The Two Weeker
description: Easy distribution of a vanilla+ custom pack so I don't have to upload a new ZIP every time we update
body: The Two Weeker is a lightweight, vanilla plus modpack, aiming to keep that vanilla feel as closely as possible while adding in some quality of life! With notable additions such as backpacks, an (optional) immersive minimap requiring a map to be in your inventory, and a Terraria-like storage mod with a button in your inventory to stack duplicate items to nearby containers!
